messages:
Aisha: Hey folks - need a tiny customer-facing runbook for onboarding teams hitting sporadic streaming hiccups and token spikes. One A4, simple steps, two quick snippets.
Tom: Make it super actionable: what to check now, what to change, what to send us.
Ben: Proposed 3-step quick checklist:
1) Confirm SDK >= 1.5.2 (fixes several stream reconnect bugs).
2) Try non-stream fallback: stream=false + max_tokens=140.
3) If streaming needed, lower batch_window_ms to 20-40ms and enable token_surge_guard with action=throttle.
Maya: Add a "what we need from you" box: request_id(s), last 30s client logs, network type, and a sample prompt.
Aisha: Telemetry checks to include (Console or we can run): avg_tokens_per_session_24h, 95p_latency_stream_24h, stream_disconnects_per_10k. Add healthy thresholds: tokens <800, 95p <600ms, disconnects <5/10k.
CS Bot: Sample queries saved to internal console.
Ben: Tiny curl fallback to paste: 
```\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","stream":false,"max_tokens":140,"prompt":"<short prompt>"}'\n```
Maya: Python progressive-batch + fallback snippet: 
```\nfrom redwood import RedwoodClient\nclient = RedwoodClient(token=TOKEN)\ntry:\n  out = client.generate(model='redwood-mini', stream=True, batch_window_ms=30)\nexcept Exception:\n  out = client.generate(model='redwood-mini', stream=False, max_tokens=140)\n```
Tom: Escalation rules: >=2 verified streaming incidents in 48h -> schedule 30m enablement + priority warm-pool prefill. Also flag renewal-risk if usage or engagement drops >20% after incidents.
Aisha: Tone: "Were here to help — try these quick steps and well jump on a 30-minute troubleshooting session if the issue continues."
Ben: Add note: if issue happens during demo/onboarding, rollback to non-stream and collect request_ids for postmortem.
CS Bot: Quickcard auto-saved: https://internal.redwood/cs/quickcards/stream-runbook-2745678901 (review reminder 15:30 PT).
Aisha: Thanks — Ill polish the card and send to the pilot list after Mayas copy edit.
